custom_namespace_boundary: The shared neutral table does not define props.type, entity.type, lighting.source.type, body.parts, body.part.presence or air.presence. These exact source-supported obligations remain requirements, not universal approved vocabulary. Their schema/meaning and independently authored core witness must be reviewed; no props.type→entity.type, face→eyes, owner_kind→fact, air_volume→generic_present or required-part-list→anatomy alias is inferred.
existing_owner_boundary: Existing owner+grounded role resolution establishes an addressable existing owner in current admission. It does not substitute for an explicitly authored typed prerequisite: current admission matches dimension/property/type/value and same actual owner separately. Retain source-supported generic existence as common entity.presence rather than quietly deleting P; owner-only cores still lack that explicit fact under this proposed inventory. Removing redundant generic P would be a different manually reviewed contract choice, not this namespace correction. Anatomy, exact material/type, part relations and context never follow automatically from an owner or role label.
